title: trials.jsonl record
description: One trial: one line of trials.jsonl, the registry-format extract the score table is derived from. The market's required-columns.yaml (results) says what `result` holds. The raw log stays in its own format under raw-log/.

case_hash.description: sha256 of that frozen case (python -m validator hash-cases).

started_at.description: ISO 8601 with time zone. Required for run attempts.

input.description: Optional: what the system was given. Left out for hidden cases.

output.description: Optional: what the system or method produced, if short. The raw log holds the full transcript.

result.description: Scored fields; see the market's required-columns.yaml (results).

source.description: Wrapped attempts: where in the released data this record comes from.

harness.description: Free-form: harness name, version, commit, original log id and hash.

raw_ref.description: Where this trial is in the raw log (sample id, line, offset).
